scope: Current-read failure and deactivation discard displayed native Properties values/Undo; derived field visibility follows valid model ownership/current authority

resolvedFinding.issue: Discarding snapshot would make the prior nil!=true derived visibility predicate reveal hidden Source/Topic/Word sections outside the view snapshot guard.
resolvedFinding.correction: Current predicate requires active and no pending review; configured native stores require a real snapshot; only the previous source-only/no-store fallback remains.

verifiedBySource: Epoch/read-request guards still reject superseded read errors and old-owner results before any state clearing.

Current read failure clears only snapshot/Undo, marks needsReview, and retains uncertain pendingEdit. Explicit successful review clears review state; stale or ordinary successful reads cannot silently discard pending review.
Deactivation invalidates reads/ownership and clears prior snapshot/Undo before a new owner loads; a pending write remains review-required.
Derived Source/Topic/Word sections remain hidden during failed/currently invalid state and reactivate only from actual current visibility preferences.

Regression assertions cover forbidden and changed-document read failures, all3 derived fields, inactive and pending-new-owner phases, exact successful-review restoration, and no additional suspended write dispatch.
The old owner-reactivation test changes its expected retained snapshot to nil explicitly; no other original method assertion is weakened.
countBoundary: Two new @Test methods; the failure method contains two loop scenarios. Do not infer three separately enumerated test cases from the loop.
